title: HYDRA-EO visualization catalog
description: Generated catalog for the HYDRA-EO scientific webpage and EO Explorer.
manual_editing: Do not edit this file by hand. Put files in visualization-data/data-to-import/ and rerun the import script.
source_policy: Large source data are stored locally under visualization-data/data-imported/ and excluded from git.

datasets.title: Chaparrillo Sentinel-2 surface reflectance subset

provenance.processing_chain: Copied from data/processed/s2_to_rm.tif and losslessly converted to a DEFLATE-compressed Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF with GDAL. RGB uses source bands B4, B3, and B2.
provenance.processing_level: Source repository labels the file processed; exact Sentinel-2 processing level not provided.
provenance.quality: Sentinel-2 SCL is present as source band 11; no quality mask is applied automatically.
provenance.known_limitations: Acquisition date, product identifier, atmospheric-correction method, calibration record, and data license are not provided. No stress or disease inference is made. Sixteen source paths contain byte-identical copies and are represented once.
provenance.contact: Carlos Luis Camino González, Wageningen University & Research

datasets.license: No data license stated in the source repository; public GitHub access only.
datasets.citation: CCGCAM (2026). HYDRA-EO Geospatial Dataset, source commit f33b294f0d3e364afade6a739fc4fea473fff090. https://github.com/CCGCAM/HYDRA-EO-Geospatial-dataset

datasets.title: Synthetic EnMAP-like 30 m 200-band cube

provenance.processing_chain: Generated in the source repository by scripts/1-generate_multiresolution_rasters.R, then converted to COG without changing values.
provenance.known_limitations: Explicitly generated by scripts/1-generate_multiresolution_rasters.R using runif(), rnorm(), and fixed random seeds. This is synthetic method-development material, not an observation, measurement, sensor product, or scientific result. The source EnMAP and PRISMA files are byte-identical and share one imported COG.

provenance.processing_chain: One byte-identical copy retained from nine source paths under biochemistry, calibration, genomics, leaf physiology, metabolomics, qPCR, visual scoring, and metadata folders.
provenance.known_limitations: The nine files are identical despite representing different folder roles. Coordinates and field meanings are not supported by a protocol in the repository.
